description.describe_ch: 應用電腦科技來分析並轉換資料為有用的視覺化資訊，內容包含學習資料類型及資料清洗技巧，並使用模組與套件進行數據視覺化分析，使用的工具包括Power BI與Python之NumPy、Pandas及Matplotlib。
description.describe_eh: This course applies computer technology to analyze and convert data into useful visual information. The content Includes learning data types and data cleaning techniques, and use modules and packages for data visualization analysis. The tools used include Power BI and Python's NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib.

targets.describe_ch: 可應用資訊工具進行企業資料視覺化
targets.describe_en: Students can utilize information technology to visualize enterprise data.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 課程介紹與資料視覺化原理

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
認識 Tableau 平台與生態系統
安裝 Tableau Public / Desktop 版本
了解數據分析師的角色與職涯發展
快速展示 Tableau 介面與基本功能
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Introduction to Tableau platform and ecosystem

*Installing Tableau Public / Desktop

*Understanding the role and career path of a data analyst

*Quick demo of Tableau interface and basic features

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
了解 Tableau Public vs Desktop 差異
匯入數據集並檢視數據源介面
製作基本長條圖與圓餅圖
簡單儀表板設計與匯出視覺化結果
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Understanding differences between Tableau Public and Desktop

*Importing datasets and exploring the data source interface

*Creating basic bar and pie charts

*Simple dashboard design and exporting visualizations

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
資料檢視與欄位類型變更
拆分與重新命名欄位
了解即時連線 vs 抽取連線
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Reviewing data and modifying field data types

*Splitting and renaming fields

*Understanding live vs extract connections

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
建立群組與別名
資料排序：手動、字母順序、欄位排序
基本聚合函數：計數、平均值、中位數
交叉表與熱力圖的應用
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Creating groups and aliases

*Sorting data: manual, alphabetical, and by field

*Basic aggregation functions: count, average, median

*Applications of crosstabs and heat maps

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
基礎篩選功能：包含 / 排除
文字篩選與相關篩選
日期篩選：相對日期 vs 具體日期
衡量篩選效能對 Tableau 運算的影響
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Basic filtering: include / exclude

*Text filters and related filters

*Date filters: relative vs specific dates

*Assessing the impact of filters on Tableau performance

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
雙軸圖表與移動平均線
散點圖與數據格式化
地理資訊視覺化（地圖與密度圖）
設定適當區域以優化地圖視覺效果
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Dual-axis charts and moving averages

*Scatter plots and data formatting

*Geospatial visualizations (maps and density maps)

*Setting map regions for optimal clarity

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
儀表板與工作表的區別
儀表板互動與篩選應用
儀表板設計最佳實踐
任務：建立個人化儀表板
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Differences between dashboards and worksheets

*Interactive dashboards and filter applications

*Best practices in dashboard design

*Assignment: Create a personalized dashboard

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
數據分析專案管理基礎（Agile vs Waterfall）
需求範圍控制與版本管理
數據視覺化的商業價值
成為成功的數據分析師
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Basics of data analytics project management (Agile vs Waterfall)

*Scope control and versioning

*Business value of data visualization

*Becoming a successful data analyst

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
缺失值處理與數據格式轉換
文字處理函數（分割、替換、長度）
數據表的旋轉（Pivot）與結構調整
多數據源連線與關聯設定
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Handling missing values and formatting conversions

*Text functions: split, replace, length

*Pivoting and reshaping data tables

*Connecting and relating multiple data sources

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
IF、IIF、CASE 條件語句
AND、OR 運算符的應用
處理 NULL 值的特殊函數
任務：使用條件運算撰寫數據規則
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Using IF, IIF, and CASE statements

*Applying AND / OR operators

*Functions for handling NULL values

*Assignment: Write data rules using conditional logic

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
日期函數（DATEDIFF、DATEADD）
指數、對數、平方根運算
級聯計算與累計成長率
資料排名與百分比計算
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Date functions: DATEDIFF, DATEADD

*Exponentials, logarithms, and square roots

*Cumulative calculations and growth rates

*Ranking and percentage calculations

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
高級地圖應用（雙軸地圖、地區分組）
透過參數控制地圖範圍與顏色
熱力圖與密度圖的進階應用
任務：建構互動式地圖視覺化
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Advanced map techniques: dual-axis maps, region grouping

*Using parameters to control map range and color

*Heatmap and density map enhancements

*Assignment: Build an interactive geographic visualization

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
固定（FIXED）、包含（INCLUDE）、排除（EXCLUDE）計算
跨不同維度計算指標
多層級數據匯總與比較分析
LOD 計算案例實作
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE LOD expressions

*Calculating metrics across different dimensions

*Multi-level data aggregation and comparative analysis

*Hands-on practice with LOD scenarios

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
參數（Parameters）的應用
參考線、趨勢線與預測模型
叢集分析（Clustering）與統計摘要
儀表板設計的最終調整
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Applying parameters in dashboards

*Reference lines, trend lines, and forecasting models

*Clustering and descriptive statistics

*Final dashboard design refinements

weeklyScds.tpd_ass:
期末專案展示與同儕回饋
討論 Tableau 認證考試與進階學習資源
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
*Final project presentations and peer feedback

*Discussion on Tableau certification and advanced learning resources

gradeRules.evalb_memo: 上機考試: 實作能力考核
期末專題: 內容深度與完整性、創新與獨特性、邏輯結構與組織、專業性與資料支持、口語表達和演示技巧
獨立思考和分析、尊重與合作、主題關聯性

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: 平時成績(作業、出席、課堂參與)30%、期中專題教試35%、期末專題報告35%
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 我們期待每位學生能夠保持課堂的良好秩序與高度專注。請準時參加每堂課，並按照指定的時間準時提交作業，這有助於培養你的時間管理能力與責任感。在課堂中，我們鼓勵積極參與，不僅可以提出問題、分享想法，還能夠加深對課題的理解。同時，請保持良好的課堂秩序，尊重教師和同學，避免影響他人的學習經驗。這些守則有助於營造一個互相尊重、合作學習的環境，讓我們共同受益並取得更好的學習成果。感謝你的配合與努力。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en: We expect every student to maintain a well-ordered and highly focused classroom environment. Please attend each class on time and submit assignments by the specified deadlines, as this will help develop your time management skills and sense of responsibility. Active participation is strongly encouraged—asking questions, sharing ideas, and engaging in discussions will deepen your understanding of the subject matter. At the same time, please uphold proper classroom etiquette by showing respect to your instructor and classmates, and avoid disrupting others' learning experiences. These guidelines help create a respectful and collaborative learning environment, enabling all of us to benefit and achieve better outcomes. Thank you for your cooperation and commitment.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: In this course, all assignments, the midterm exam, and the final project must adhere strictly to the principles of academic integrity. Plagiarism or any form of dishonest behavior is strictly prohibited. Any violation of these principles will result in appropriate actions based on the severity of the case, including but not limited to receiving no credit for the affected work. Students are strongly encouraged to demonstrate their academic abilities through independent thinking and dedicated effort. This approach not only builds a solid foundation of knowledge and professional skills but also provides lasting benefits in both academic pursuits and future career development.
